title: The US is winning the AI race in commercialization
description: Analysis arguing that the US is winning the AI race where it matters most: commercialization and practical application of AI technologies, rather than just research breakthroughs.
author: Hacker News community

title: Notion turns workspace into AI agent hub
description: Notion launched a developer platform that transforms its workspace into a hub for AI agents, allowing developers to build and integrate AI agents directly into Notion workspaces.
author: Sarah Perez

title: AI voice startup Vapi hits $500M valuation
description: AI voice startup Vapi reached a $500M valuation after winning Amazon Ring as a customer over 40 competitors. Their AI voice technology is being adopted for customer service and voice applications.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Adaption aims big with AutoScientist
description: Adaption announced AutoScientist, an AI tool designed to help models train themselves, representing advances in self-improving AI systems and automated research capabilities.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Anthropic Cat Wu on AI anticipating user needs
description: Anthropic's Cat Wu discussed the future of AI systems that can anticipate user needs before users themselves know what they are, representing a shift toward proactive AI assistance.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Leaving GitHub for Forgejo
description: Developer discusses reasons for leaving GitHub for Forgejo, a self-hosted Git forge. Raises questions about platform lock-in, open source alternatives, and developer tool choices in the AI era.
author: jorijn

title: GM lays off IT workers to hire AI specialists
description: General Motors laid off hundreds of IT workers to hire employees with stronger AI skills, reflecting a broader trend of companies restructuring their technical workforce to focus on AI capabilities.
author: Kirsten Korosec

title: Google brings agentic AI and vibe-coded widgets to Android
description: Google announced agentic AI capabilities and 'vibe-coded' widgets for Android, allowing users to create widgets through natural language prompts. The 'Create My Widget' feature enables anyone to generate custom widgets without coding.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Digg relaunches as AI news aggregator
description: Social news pioneer Digg relaunched as an AI-powered news aggregator, attempting to reinvent itself for the AI era by using algorithms to curate and summarize news content.
author: Sarah Perez

title: The Changelog: Amelia Wattenberger on Intent and agent-first design
description: Interview with designer Amelia Wattenberger about Intent at Augment Code. Discussion on the identity crisis developers face as agents take over, the redesign of developer tooling for agent-first workflows, and the evolution from autocomplete to chat to UI. Key insight: prototyping got easier but finishing got harder.
author: The Changelog

title: Googlebooks and vibe-coded widgets announced at Android Show
description: Google announced Googlebooks and vibe-coded widgets at their Android Show event, showcasing the company's push toward AI-generated and customizable widget creation for Android users.
author: Sarah Perez, Ivan Mehta, Aisha Malik

title: The Changelog: Astral joins OpenAI
description: Discussion about Astral joining OpenAI and what this signals about the center of gravity moving for developer tools. Also covered: LiteLLM supply-chain attack, OpenCode as an open-source coding-agent stack, Rust's reality check on pain points, and WorkOS pushing AuthKit into CLI auth.
author: The Changelog

title: A History of IDEs at Google
description: Detailed discussion about the evolution of Integrated Development Environments used internally at Google, providing insights into how a major tech company approaches developer tooling.
author: laurentlb

title: The Changelog: Tailscale's TSIDP, TSNet, and Aperture
description: Interview with Tailscale co-founder David Carney about TSIDP (clickless auth), TSNet apps, multiple tailnets for isolation, and Aperture - Tailscale's private AI gateway for API key management, observability, and agent security.
author: The Changelog

title: OpenAI's WebRTC Problem with voice AI
description: Luke Curley highlights that WebRTC is designed to degrade and drop audio packets during poor network conditions to keep latency low. But for LLM voice prompts, this is problematic - users would rather wait extra 200ms for accurate prompts than have garbage input due to dropped packets. The implementation is hard-coded for real-time latency.
author: Luke Curley (via Simon Willison)

title: The Changelog: Iran bombed AWS, OpenAI GPT-5.4, living brain cells play DOOM
description: Discussion of major AI news: Iran allegedly bombed AWS data centers to take down Claude, OpenAI released GPT-5.4 with significant coding improvements, and living brain cells were taught to play DOOM. Also covered: new MacBook Pros with M5 Pro/Max.
author: The Changelog

title: The Changelog: Burke Holland on Opus 4.5 and AI coding
description: Burke Holland from GitHub Copilot discusses how Opus 4.5 changed everything in AI coding, the 2x usage bump from Claude, and GPT-5.3 Codex living up to the hype. Deep dive into practical AI coding workflows.
author: The Changelog

title: Using Claude Code: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of HTML
description: Thariq Shihipar (Claude Code team) advocates for HTML over Markdown as LLM output format. HTML enables SVG diagrams, interactive widgets, in-page navigation, and richer explanations. Simon tested this by having GPT-5.5 create an HTML explanation of the copy.fail Linux security exploit, producing rich, interactive documentation.
author: Simon Willison (citing Thariq Shihipar)
